text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. How did you view my run 
today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, she was just as 
magnificent and dignified as ever. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting on it now, it seemed as though 
there were faint signs of fatigue right 
from the start of her run.
choice_data_list: Maybe I was a little tired...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"So you see it that way too, just as I 
thought. It seems my physical conditioning 
was a bit lax."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, I am not blaming you in the slightest. 
I was being a bit impatient myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us both be mindful of this in the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Symboli Rudolf said, it looks like 
we'll need to review our upcoming 
schedule.
